overview.body: Initial Nymphs Sprite scaffold. Targets Z-Image Turbo through Nymphs Image with a Z-Image-compatible sprite LoRA, Z-Image ControlNet Union, and Depth Anything, while keeping Sprite Foundry's ComfyUI workflow contract as reference material for parity.

dependencies.zimage: Required generation backend for Tongyi-MAI/Z-Image-Turbo and Z-Image Turbo LoRA loading.
dependencies.depth_anything: depth-anything/Depth-Anything-V2-Small-hf for depth references and derived depth maps.
dependencies.nymphscore: Target orchestration layer for replacing the captured ComfyUI workflow behavior.
dependencies.comfyui: Optional reference runtime only while parity work is in progress.

notes: Initial scaffold captures Sprite Foundry ComfyUI workflow templates, Z-Image Turbo request profiles, pixel-art LoRA candidates, Z-Image ControlNet Union, Depth Anything, a sprite-specific Manager UI, and the NymphsCore module contract.

The direction runner calls Nymphs Image /generate with the chosen Z-Image Turbo LoRA. ControlNet and Depth Anything fetch/status surfaces are first-class; Z-Image ControlNet generation needs a backend path because the installed diffusers runtime exposes ZImagePipeline but not ZImageControlNetPipeline.
v0.1.1 writes Sprite Foundry-style batch artifacts: copied direction images, sprite_batch.json, and an optional contact sheet when Pillow is available.
v0.1.2 ports the MIT-licensed Sprite Foundry post-processing method and exposes --sprite-size from 24 to 512 pixels, defaulting to 96 for Z-Image detail retention.
v0.1.3 fixes the default mks0813 LoRA filename, emits standard MODEL FETCH progress, reports downloaded sprite assets in status, and adds module-owned LoRA weight deletion.
v0.1.4 consolidates LoRA, ControlNet, and Depth downloads into one module-owned Asset Fetch dropdown.
v0.1.5 makes Complete Sprite Package fetch both LoRAs, with mks0813 selected by default until the UI exposes LoRA switching.
v0.1.6 routes Asset Fetch through the existing fetch_lora capability so older Manager sessions do not grey out the submit button.
v0.1.7 rebuilds the module-owned UI from the Nymphs Image rail/stage pattern, with a generated sprite preview, contact-sheet thumbnails, compact status, and no dashboard-card layout.

v0.1.8 removes asset download controls from the custom generation UI, keeps asset fetch in the module detail action group, adds run-level downloaded-LoRA selection, and restores the Nymphs Image strip organizer/folder picker pattern.
v0.1.9 adds a sprite prompt preset dropdown, separates source-image generation from generate-and-process, and removes the always-visible log from the UI stage.

v0.1.10 replaces the starter prompt presets with Sprite Foundry-derived subjects, inlines the Nymphs Image forest background during install, moves source generation into the Z-Image stage, and lets the strip picker load recent Z-Image outputs.
